title: China Bars SoftBank’s $5.4 Billion ABB Robotics Deal Locally
summary: China’s foreign investment security review has prohibited SoftBank from implementing its roughly $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB’s robotics business in China, ABB confirmed on Nov. 5 after receiving notice from the review authority.
